review:
John Hunter's Egyptian adventure on six Megaways reels, with up to 117,649 ways. On any spin, a random symbol can be picked to expand across reels at the end – more base-game action than most book slots.

Three or more scatters give 10 free spins with one expanding symbol for the whole round, and three more retrigger 10. An ante bet boosts your bonus chances. Up to 10,000x. The default RTP is 96%, below Pragmatic's usual top, so check your casino's version.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
